FYI: for the curious, a snippet of the URI syntax BNF from https://www.rfc-editor.org/info/rfc3986/#appendix-A
URI           = scheme ":" hier-part [ "?" query ] [ "#" fragment ]
hier-part     = "//" authority path-abempty
              / path-absolute
              / path-rootless
              / path-empty
...
authority     = [ userinfo "@" ] host [ ":" port ]
